market.name: Marketplace
market.blurb: A small, steady gold income; can be built in any province.

granary.name: Granary
granary.blurb: Raises the nation’s food storage by 1000 (it starts at 2000).

storehouse.name: Storehouse
storehouse.blurb: Raises the nation’s wood storage by 1000 (it starts at 2000).

bank.name: Bank
bank.blurb: Raises the nation’s gold storage by 1000 (it starts at 2000).

forge.name: Forge
forge.blurb: Unlocks Military research and adds 2 Military points every 10 s. Upgrades to a Battle Forge, then a War Forge.

magetower.name: Mage Tower
magetower.blurb: Unlocks Magic research and adds 2 Magic points every 10 s. Upgrades to a Mage Sanctum, then a Mage Arcanum.

temple.name: Temple
temple.blurb: A marble temple: adds 2 Government research points every payout. No research needed to build it; it never upgrades.

pyre.name: Sacred Pyre
pyre.blurb: Raised by a Warlock on a free building plot. Burns 10 wood every 10 s for 20 gold. Build it up into a Grand Pyre: 20 wood for 50 gold. One per living Warlock.

army.name: Army
army.blurb: A group of soldiers that moves as one.

d-spear.name: Spearman
d-spear.blurb: Spear, Leather I armor. +50% damage against cavalry.

d-sword.name: Footman
d-sword.blurb: Short Sword, Leather I armor. Parry: take 10% less damage.

d-club.name: Clubman
d-club.blurb: Club, Leather I armor. Crushing: ignores half of enemy armor, and deals 150% damage to soldiers in plate.

d-rider.name: Rider
d-rider.blurb: Spear, Leather I armor, Rouncey. +50% damage against cavalry.

d-sw-spear.name: Spear Berserker
d-sw-spear.blurb: Spear, Staghide I armor. +50% damage against cavalry.

d-sw-axe.name: Axe Berserker
d-sw-axe.blurb: Hand Axe, Staghide I armor. Critical strike: each blow has a 10% chance to do double damage.

d-sw-club.name: Club Berserker
d-sw-club.blurb: Club, Staghide I armor. Crushing: ignores half of enemy armor, and deals 150% damage to soldiers in plate.

d-wd-sword.name: Sword Protector
d-wd-sword.blurb: Dirk, Spiritweave I armor. Parry: take 10% less damage.

d-wd-spear.name: Spear Protector
d-wd-spear.blurb: Spear, Spiritweave I armor. +50% damage against cavalry.

d-wd-club.name: Club Protector
d-wd-club.blurb: Club, Spiritweave I armor. Crushing: ignores half of enemy armor, and deals 150% damage to soldiers in plate.

d-wd-champ.name: Champion
d-wd-champ.blurb: Champion Sword, Ornate I armor. Parry: take 10% less damage.

d-sw-ogre.name: Ogre
d-sw-ogre.blurb: Club, Staghide I armor, Ogre. Crushing: ignores half of enemy armor, and deals 150% damage to soldiers in plate.

mage:A.name: Mage
mage:A.blurb: Casts the spells of your school. Joins an army to fight in it and power its battle spells.

m-ent.name: Walking Ent
m-ent.blurb: An old tree that has pulled up its roots: as strong as two Riders. 100 wood when felled.

m-zombie.name: Zombie
m-zombie.blurb: The restless dead of the marshes: half a Footman each, but they come in numbers. 20 gold each.

m-jackal.name: Jackal-man
m-jackal.blurb: A desert hunter with a jackal’s head, a long curved sword and mail. 30 gold each.

thug:A.name: Thug
thug:A.blurb: Doesn’t fight. Sits in a Thug Den and squeezes 1 gold out of the neighborhood every 10 s.

wd-elem.name: Grand Elemental
wd-elem.blurb: A towering man of living water, summoned by a Druid for 2 minutes: 500 health, no armor, 50 damage a swing.

b-reddragon.name: Red Dragon
b-reddragon.blurb: A boss: power 30000. Beating it gives the Red Dragon Skull.

b-bluedragon.name: Blue Dragon
b-bluedragon.blurb: A boss: power 40000. Beating it gives the Blue Dragon Skull.

b-golddragon.name: Gold Dragon
b-golddragon.blurb: A boss: power 50000. Beating it gives the Gold Dragon Skull.

b-skeletonking.name: Skeleton King
b-skeletonking.blurb: A boss: power 25000. Beating it gives the King’s Crown.

b-inferno.name: Walking Inferno
b-inferno.blurb: A boss: power 30000. Beating it gives the Essence of Flame.

b-scarabs.name: Scarab Army
b-scarabs.blurb: A boss: power 35000. Beating it gives the Lidless Eye.

b-sherman.name: General Sherman
b-sherman.blurb: A boss: power 20000. Beating it gives the Enchanted Stump.

b-ursa.name: Ursa Major
b-ursa.blurb: A boss: power 25000. Beating it gives the Grips of the Beast.

b-serpent.name: Winged Serpent
b-serpent.blurb: A boss: power 30000. Beating it gives the Winged Slippers.

rng-realm.name: Crossbowman
rng-realm.blurb: Ranged soldier with a Hand-drawn Crossbow: 20 health, no armor, attack 6. Full damage from the back row, only 40% in the front row (or in an army of fewer than 6). Fills an army from the back. Research Lever Crossbows to re-arm them.

rng-swamp.name: Slinger
rng-swamp.blurb: Ranged soldier with a Wool Sling: 20 health, no armor, attack 6. Full damage from the back row, only 40% in the front row (or in an army of fewer than 6). Fills an army from the back. Research Braided Slings to re-arm them.

rng-wood.name: Archer
rng-wood.blurb: Ranged soldier with a Short Bow: 20 health, no armor, attack 6. Full damage from the back row, only 40% in the front row (or in an army of fewer than 6). Fills an army from the back. Research Composite Bows to re-arm them.
